SECULAR HUMANISM IS BETTER FOR SOCIETY · MATT DILLAHUNTY
"There's no agreement on what God wants."

Dillahunty argues that Christian disagreement about divine purposes obstructs a common method for resolving practical social questions in the present world.

"

CHRISTIANITY IS BETTER FOR SOCIETY · RANDAL RAUSER
"Christianity and humanism are not scorched earth enemies."

Rauser establishes shared commitments to humility, human nobility, and solidarity before arguing that mere Christianity cultivates those values more effectively.
